 News 
 by Felix Page 
 3 mins read 
 5 November 2026 
 Follow @felix_page_ 
 Share 
 Toyota will launch the new Corolla by 2030 with the option of an all-new hybrid system that promises to return almost 100mpg in daily use.
 Previewed by a rakish, futuristic concept at last year's Tokyo motor show , the 13th generation of the world's best-selling car will be a complete technical and visual departure from the current model.
